slots.title: Tokenization and stablecoins may weather Democrats' sweep as broader crypto rules face uncertainty
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Wall Street's push to bring finance onto blockchain rails may continue under existing laws, though the SEC and CFTC face tougher oversight and questions over how long their rules will last, experts said.

slots.title: Crypto's Washington hopes fade, but Grayscale and BlackRock see growth ahead
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The asset manager says global demand and institutional adoption will sustain the industry despite a political setback, while BlackRock sees little impact on its crypto business.

slots.title: AI PACs spent millions trying to shape Congress — here’s how they fared
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: AI industry PACs spent millions influencing the 2026 midterms, with mixed results. Political groups are already looking toward the next election cycle.
